name: lambda-lang-support
description: Language support for Lambda Calculus scripts (.lambda files) with LSP integration

commands.title: Lambda: Reduce Expression
commands.description: Reduce the current expression to normal form

commands.title: Lambda: Configure LSP Server
commands.description: Set the path to the lambda CLI executable

commands.title: Lambda: Toggle Inlay Hints
commands.description: Toggle Inlay Hints for reduce/assert commands

lambda.lsp.enable.description: Enable Lambda LSP server for language support

lambda.lsp.serverPath.description: Path to the lambda CLI executable or command. Can be 'lambda' if in PATH, or a full path like '/usr/local/bin/lambda'

lambda.lsp.serverArgs.description: Additional arguments to pass to the Lambda LSP server

lambda.lsp.debug.enable.description: Enable verbose LSP protocol debugging logs from both client and server

lambda.lsp.debug.trace.description: Trace level for Language Client protocol logs

lambda.inlayHints.enable.description: Enable Inlay Hints for reduce/assert commands to display reduced forms

lambda.completion.enable.description: Enable code completion for Lambda keywords and commands

lambda.hover.enable.description: Enable hover information for Lambda commands

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle-deps
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.bundle-deps: mkdir -p out/vendor && cp -R node_modules/vscode-languageclient out/vendor/ && cp -R node_modules/vscode-jsonrpc out/vendor/ && cp -R node_modules/vscode-languageserver-protocol out/vendor/ && cp -R node_modules/vscode-languageserver-types out/vendor/ && cp -R node_modules/semver out/vendor/ || true
